# Test: apx opclass classifies the operations of an OpenAPI spec
# (native Go, no external tools)

# The text table, sorted by path and then by method
exec apx opclass spec.yaml
stdout 'METHOD +PATH +OPERATION ID +CLASS +STREAMING +RULE'
stdout 'GET +/groups +AccountOrganizationGroups_List +list +false +name'
stdout 'GET +/groups/\{id\} +AccountOrganizationGroups_Read +read +false +name'
stdout 'POST +/groups +- +write +false +shape'
stdout 'GET +/events +watchEvents +custom +true +explicit'
stdout '4 operations: read=1 list=1 write=1 custom=1'

# JSON output
exec apx opclass spec.yaml --format json
stdout '"operationId": "AccountOrganizationGroups_Read"'
stdout '"class": "read"'
stdout '"basePath": "/api/v1"'
stdout '"list": 1'

# The global --json flag gives the same format
exec apx --json opclass spec.yaml
stdout '"streaming": true'

# --write adds the extension where it is missing and keeps the other lines
exec apx opclass spec.yaml --write
stdout '4 operations: read=1 list=1 write=1 custom=1'
cmp spec.yaml want.yaml

# A second --write changes nothing
exec apx opclass spec.yaml --write
cmp spec.yaml want.yaml

# An invalid explicit class fails
! exec apx opclass bad.yaml
stderr 'invalid x-operation-class "fast"'

# An unknown output format fails
! exec apx opclass spec.yaml --format xml
stderr 'invalid --format'

# A missing file fails
! exec apx opclass missing.yaml

-- spec.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Groups   # a comment that stays
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/api/v1
paths:
  /groups:
    get:
      operationId: AccountOrganizationGroups_List
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
    post:
      summary: no operationId
      responses:
        '201': {description: created}
  /groups/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: AccountOrganizationGroups_Read
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
  /events:
    get:
      operationId: watchEvents
      x-operation-class: custom
      responses:
        '200':
          description: a stream
          content:
            text/event-stream: {}
-- want.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Groups   # a comment that stays
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/api/v1
paths:
  /groups:
    get:
      operationId: AccountOrganizationGroups_List
      x-operation-class: list
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
    post:
      x-operation-class: write
      summary: no operationId
      responses:
        '201': {description: created}
  /groups/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: AccountOrganizationGroups_Read
      x-operation-class: read
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
  /events:
    get:
      operationId: watchEvents
      x-operation-class: custom
      responses:
        '200':
          description: a stream
          content:
            text/event-stream: {}
-- bad.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
paths:
  /a:
    get:
      x-operation-class: fast
